newsitem.title: USA: ECC to hire banker to help find buyer.
newsitem.headline: ECC to hire banker to help find buyer.

text.p: ECC International Corp said on Tuesday it expected to hire an investment banking firm by the end of this month to help the company obtain a buyer.
Based on a preliminary count of votes cast at the company's annual meeting, stockholders voted to have the board of directors engage an investment banking firm, ECC said.
The firm would seek to obtain a purchaser on terms and conditions that the board felt were in the best interests of the company, the company said.
Stockholders also voted to have the board amend company by-laws to allow holders of 10 percent of the company's stock to call a special meeting of stockholders, ECC said.
